scenes.text: Alaska is the most northern, most western, and most eastern US state.
Most northern is easy: Utqiagvik, Alaska, is the northernmost town in the country.
Most western too, because the Aleutian Islands stretch far out toward Russia.
But that chain goes so far, it crosses the one hundred eightieth meridian.
So a few islands, like Semisopochnoi, sit in the Eastern Hemisphere.
By longitude, the most eastern point of the United States is in Alaska, not Maine.

title: Alaska is the most EASTERN state too 🧭
caption: Alaska's Aleutian Islands cross the 180th meridian, so islands like Semisopochnoi lie in the Eastern Hemisphere. That makes Alaska the northernmost, westernmost and (by longitude) easternmost US state. 🗺️
